title: DecisionRights
description: Machine-readable decision-class table. Each decision class names a single owner and a documented escalation path. Migrated from docs/CONSTITUTION.md §Decision rights during the 2026-05-15 CONSTITUTION strike per root-hub-pointers.json _retired_constitutional_authority migration map. Per-team RACI detail (atomic responsibility allocation) lives in docs/RACI-OWNERSHIP.md; this file is the top-level class table.

_meta.applies_to: every change touching a named decision class
_meta.purpose: Canonical decision-class table. Used by PR-traceability gate to verify changes cite their decision class and by RACI lane to verify per-team responsibility allocation.

decision_classes.applies_to: amendments to specs/decision-principles.json, forbidden-operations.json, decision-rights.json, governance-amendment.json (the post-CONSTITUTION-strike doctrinal substrate)
contract changes that cross µservice or axis boundaries (per ADR-0011 cross-axis-contract-registry)
architecture decisions internal to one of the 7 axes (SaaS · Workspace · Vertical · Foundry · Cloud · Search · Ads-Analytics)
feature decisions internal to one product within an axis
team-internal conventions, dev-loop choices, on-call rotation, etc.
binding a capability to an autonomy tier; uplift requires policy + runtime gate per FO-10
promotion of any new doc into docs/ as canonical surface
retirement of any canonical doc (including the 2026-05-15 CONSTITUTION.md retirement itself)
decisions internal to a regional localization pack (KR is pack #1 per ADR-0064)
Sev-1 / Sev-2 incidents; postmortem authorship; mistake-class assignment in docs/MISTAKES-LEDGER.md
license-class review for any new dep crossing tier boundaries (per ADR-0013 product-license-policy)

mechanical_components.verifies: PR body cites a decision_class id from this spec
per-team RACI allocation in docs/RACI-OWNERSHIP.md is consistent with decision_classes here

enforcement.gap: No lane validates that the *named owner* in a PR body matches the actual decision-class owner declared here. Candidate for future oya-governance-decision-class-owner-cite lane.

references: docs/RACI-OWNERSHIP.md — per-team RACI detail (sibling, not duplicate)
docs/standards/incident-management.md — DR-11 incident commander role detail
